scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:worker"
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend flask --app easy_quant.api.app:create_app run --debug --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5000
scripts.check:backend: uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend/src backend/tests backend/migrations backend/resources && uv run --project backend ruff check backend/src backend/tests backend/migrations backend/resources && uv run --project backend pyright --project backend/pyproject.toml && uv run --project backend pytest --rootdir backend
scripts.format:backend: uv run --project backend ruff format backend/src backend/tests backend/migrations backend/resources
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --project backend ruff check --fix backend/src backend/tests backend/migrations backend/resources && pnpm --dir frontend lint:fix
scripts.hooks:install: uv run --project backend pre-commit install --hook-type pre-commit --hook-type commit-msg
scripts.migrate: uv run --project backend alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
